traditional: 放 A 喺 B 度屈 C
jyutping: fong3 A hai2 B dou6 wat1 C

english.note: Use this construction when an object is placed somewhere as evidence or bait to frame C.

examples.english: They plant a phone in my bag to frame me for stealing.
examples.traditional: 佢放部手機喺我個袋度屈我偷嘢。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 fong3 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai2 ngo5 go3 doi6 dou6 wat1 ngo5 tau1 je5
